verdict.rationale: Hatchet positions itself as an orchestration platform for AI agents, so consuming MCP servers' tools is a fair question to ask of it. The only MCP-related evidence runs the other way: Hatchet exposes its workflows and tasks as tools that external agent frameworks like the Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK can invoke. Nothing in the pack shows Hatchet itself connecting to or using tools from external MCP servers.
